DTCE PDF security component: qpdf 12.4.2 (unmodified Windows x64 distribution).
Source/release: https://github.com/qpdf/qpdf/tree/v12.4.2
Archive: qpdf-12.4.2-mingw64.zip
SHA256: 773d2fa0c7d161e2271430734338e560a07b25d0edf11ceee8e53de435012766
qpdf is Apache-2.0; see LICENSE.txt and NOTICE.md for copyrights and components.
The Windows runtime DLLs are supplied unmodified from the official archive.
GCC runtime: GPLv3 with GCC Runtime Library Exception (included texts).
Corresponding GCC source: https://gcc.gnu.org/releases.html and
https://github.com/gcc-mirror/gcc (runtime library source in libgcc/libstdc++-v3).
MinGW-w64 runtime: https://www.mingw-w64.org/ and
https://github.com/mingw-w64/mingw-w64 (licenses in MINGW-COPYING.txt).

Permissions are reader-enforced. Neither qpdf encryption nor flattened pages
can guarantee that an open/printable document cannot be altered by third-party
software, reprinted to another PDF, photographed or reconstructed.
